headline: Approved consent agenda, including the BCO Ch 21 trespass appeal hearing ordinance update; chiefs gave reports with no action taken.
summary: The consent agenda was adopted by unanimous vote. It included the BCO Ch 21 Trespass Appeal Hearing Ordinance Update. Fire and police chiefs shared incident, response, and personnel data, with no action taken.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including the BCO Ch 21 Trespass Appeal Hearing Ordinance Update, by unanimous vote.

decision_titles: BCO Ch 21 Trespass Appeal Hearing Ordinance Update
plain_text:
Page 1 of 2 
 
 
Public Safety Committee 
Thursday, October 22, 2026 
Remote via Zoom/In-Person in Sharon Bushor Conference Room, 1st Floor, City Hall, 
Burlington, Vermont   
DRAFT MINUTES 
  
Members Present:  Buddy Singh (Chair), Melo Grant, Laura Sanchez-Parkinson, Evan Litwin 
  
Staff Present: Kristen Kaichen (Legal Administrative Assistant), Shawn Burke (BPD Chief), 
Michael Curtin (BFD Chief) 
 
Public Present: Chris McGrath 
 
Meeting called to order at 5:31 PM by Councilor Singh. 
  
1.   Adopt the Agenda 
     1.01 Adopt the Agenda 
  
Motion to adopt the agenda as written.    
 
Motion by Councilor Litwin, Seconded by Councilor Sanchez-Parkinson 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
2.    Adopt Minutes 
      2.01 Motion to adopt draft minutes from September 24, 2026 
 
Motion to adopt the draft minutes from September 24, 2026 as written.  
 
Motion by Councilor Litwin, Seconded by Councilor Sanchez-Parkinson 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
3.   Public Forum 
     3.01  Verbal Comments 
 
Chris McGrath commented on attending the meeting to hear updates from the chiefs and may 
speak to specific agenda items as the meeting progresses.   
 
Public Forum closed at 5:34 PM. 
 
4.   Consent Agenda 
     4.01  BCO Ch 21 Trespass Appeal Hearing Ordinance Update 
 
Motion to adopt the consent agenda as written.
Page 2 of 2 
 
 
Motion by Councilor Litwin, Seconded by Councilor Sanchez-Parkinson 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
5.  Chiefs’ Oral Report 
     5.01 Fire 
 
Chief Curtin shared the latest fire incident, response and personnel data with the Committee.  No 
action taken.  
 
     5.02 Police 
 
Chief Burke shared the latest police incident, response, and personnel data with the Committee.  
No action taken. 
 
6.  Burlington Forward 
     6.01 Burlington Forward Discussion 
 
The Committee reviewed the memo and process in developing recommended amendments to the 
Burlington Forward resolution.  No action taken.   
 
7.  Adjournment 
     7.01 Motion to Adjourn 
 
The meeting was adjourned with no objection at 7:21 PM.
